definitions: The particular way in which something exists or appears.
A type or kind of something.
A printed document with blank spaces for information to be inserted.
A long seat without a back, typically for more than one person.
A class or grade in a school.
The shape and structure of something as distinguished from its material.
A set of established ways of doing things, especially in social situations.
examples: Please fill out the forms completely.
The children sat on the forms.
She is in the fifth form.
He observed the proper forms of address.
